title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Surrender Settlement Worksheet
content:
**Worksheet clause.** The settlement figures of a Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage total-loss claim are read from the claim's total-loss declaration: the actual cash value, the unrepaired prior damage noted and the documented custom equipment value. The vehicle value is the actual cash value. The prior damage deduction is the unrepaired prior damage noted in the valuation. The adjusted value is the vehicle value less the prior damage deduction, rounded to the cent. Sales tax is the adjusted value times the policy state's sales tax percentage, rounded to the cent, and the title fee is the policy state's title fee. Custom equipment is paid at its documented value up to the option's custom equipment limit. The decided deductible is the deductible stated on the claim's latest accepted coverage decision, and the deductible charge is the decided deductible. The credit applied is the vehicle's Deductible Rewards credit balance, up to the deductible charge, and the net deductible is the deductible charge less the credit applied. The surrender settlement is the adjusted value plus sales tax plus the title fee plus custom equipment, less the net deductible, each figure rounded to the cent before it is added.

## State figures used on the worksheet

| Policy state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | Sales tax percentage | Title fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| OH | 5.75 | 15.00 |
| IN | 7.00 | 15.00 |
| KY | 6.00 | 9.00 |
| VA | 4.15 | 15.00 |
| WV | 6.00 | 15.00 |

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Figure | Record |
|---|---|---|
| A | Vehicle value: the actual cash value | Total-loss declaration |
| B | Prior damage deduction: the unrepaired prior damage noted | Total-loss declaration |
| C | Adjusted value: line A less line B, rounded to the cent | — |
| D | Sales tax: line C times the state percentage, rounded to the cent | Policy state |
| E | Title fee of the state | Policy state |
| F | Custom equipment: documented value, up to the option's custom equipment limit | Total-loss declaration; option schedule |
| G | Deductible charge: the deductible on the latest accepted coverage decision | Claim file |
| H | Credit applied: the Deductible Rewards credit balance, up to line G | Coverage record |
| I | Net deductible: line G less line H | — |
| J | Surrender settlement: lines C, D, E and F added together, less line I | — |

## Worked worksheet (hypothetical figures)

OH policy; actual cash value 18000.00; prior damage noted 400.00; documented custom equipment 800.00 under an option whose custom equipment limit is 1000; latest accepted coverage decision deductible 500.00; Deductible Rewards balance 100.00.

- C: 18000.00 less 400.00 gives 17600.00.
- D: 17600.00 times 5.75 percent gives 1012.00.
- E: 15.00. F: 800.00 (within the limit).
- H: 100.00 (below the deductible charge), so I: 500.00 less 100.00 gives 400.00.
- J: 17600.00 plus 1012.00 plus 15.00 plus 800.00 gives 19427.00; less 400.00 gives a surrender settlement of 19027.00.
